definitions.explanation: Rainfall made unusually acidic by air pollution — primarily sulfur and nitrogen oxides from factories and vehicles. A common topic in environmental discussions.

examples.japanese: {酸性雨|さんせいう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{森|もり}→森：02260_mori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{傷|いた}める→傷める：02098_itameru⟧。
{酸性雨|さんせいう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{湖|みずうみ}→湖：00867_mizuumi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{減|へ}った→減る：01985_heru⟧。
examples.english: The fish in the lake decreased due to the effects of acid rain.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大気汚染|たいきおせん}→大気汚染：09254_taikiosen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{酸性雨|さんせいう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧や⟦{農作物|のうさくぶつ}→農作物：15271_nousakubutsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}える→与える：01821_ataeru⟧。
examples.english: As air pollution advances, acid rain causes damage to buildings and crops as well.

notes:
